args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — `get_service_status` showed checkout-api on v2.3.1 was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) across all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). `list_deployments` confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back** — `rollback` to v2.3.0 in all regions; verified rollout succeeded (status `rolled_out`, `VERIFIED`).
3. **Opened incident** — SEV2 `INC-0001` for checkout-api, describing the health-check failure and the rollback action. On-call was paged.
